kill_criterion.description: On 50 open Solicitation notices with PIN: RFx document URL join ≥30%
kill_criterion.universe: dg92-zbpx type_of_notice_description=Solicitation, pin not empty, start_date >= 2025-01-01, order start_date DESC, limit 50

join_measurement.strategy: EPIN↔PIN via passport_join (exact | pin_strip_suffix | pin_prefix_of_epin | epin_prefix_of_pin); document URLs via extractRfxDocumentUrls on public_rfx_data columns only
join_measurement.verdict: Below usefulness threshold (~30%) for RFx package-document URLs (0%). EPIN join remains useful for RFx metadata. Do not edge-materialize package documents from the RFx dump.

ocp_document_links_2025_plus.note: Socrata count where document_links IS NOT NULL and start_date >= 2025-01-01

city_record_document_links_2025_plus.note: Solicitation notices with document_links non-null since 2025-01-01

historical_getfile_present.note: City Record / OCP document_links still carry GetFile attachments on pre-2025 rows (latest sample 2024-10-09); modern window is empty.

product_decision: Stop rule applied: RFx document URL join 0% on the 50-notice kill sample (and 0% on 1,470 modern Solicitation+PIN notices). Reclassify gap procurement-solicitation-documents as not_published with pointer at City Record GetFile. Keep PASSPort RFx metadata materialization; do not invent package-document URLs from the public dump.
